## 2. What to build

**§4 The composer and the grammar** (prototype frames 5, 6)
- **`+` is the one way in for everything that isn't text:** upload a file; link something (tabs All · Tasks · Notes · Events · People, recent first); create a linked task, note or event. Every way to connect lands as the same chip: `@`, `/task` `/note` `/event`, `+`, pasting a Moduo link, dragging an item from the panel or another module onto the box.

**§8 Chat knows the work** (prototype frames 4, 5)
- **A message becomes a task:** `T` on a message or ⋯ → Make a task opens the app's capture as Task with the message's words as the title draft, a removable **"From: Sofia's message in Acme"** chip and the destination set to the linked project (Inbox otherwise); ⏎ creates it and the message shows **"Became a task: ○ Get logo SVGs · Today"**, live; the task's Linked shows the message. `/task` does the same from a line you're typing. Files stay on the message.
- **References:** two new kinds. A **message** (chip: author · first words; card: author · time · conversation · two lines; "Deleted message") and a **conversation** (chip: glyph · name; card: name · linked item · people · last message). "Private item" for anything you can't read, never with a title. In running text a referenced item is a chip plus a collapsible preview card (RF-1's chat default).
- **The Message capture (⌘7 inside the capture modal):** no default destination: the picker opens focused, recent conversations and people first; a person starts a direct message; a "From:" item becomes a reference card in the message; ⏎ sends and shows "Sent to Acme · Open · Undo" (Undo deletes it within 8 s) (CH65).

## 3. Acceptance criteria

**AC9 — Chat knows the work**
- **AC9.3** a message that mentions an item leaves one "Mentioned in" line per conversation, readers only
- **AC9.4** a message and a conversation render as link, chip, card and preview, "Deleted message", "Private item" with no title
- **AC9.5** `T` / ⋯ → Make a task opens the capture with the From chip, files into the linked project, links both ways and shows "Became a task" live
- **AC9.6** the ⌘7 Message capture needs a destination, starts a direct message from a person, shows "Sent to … · Open · Undo"
- **AC9.7** `/task` `/note` `/event` create a linked item from the composer.

**AC4 — A developer team's week**
- **AC4.1** `MOD-142` typed in a message becomes a live chip with status and assignee

**AC2 — A hackathon team's weekend (the hackathon cut)**
- **AC2.4** "this is a bug, Anna takes it" becomes a task in two keys with the link both ways and its status ticking in the message

**AC1 — Trust pass (v1's fourteen trust bugs, REPLAN §1.3 B)**
- **AC1.13** "Make a task" opens the capture with the From chip and links both ways

**AC3 — A duo's week**
- **AC3.6** a message that mentions the investor's contact leaves "Mentioned in Founders · Oct 12" on the contact's Linked.

**Tests that prove them** (file · name · AC · plain English)

- `supabase/tests/chat_links.test.sql` · "linked channels and Mentioned in" · proves AC9.1–9.3, AC5.1, AC6.1, AC3.6 · One link per channel; "Start a conversation for X" picks public or private by X's visibility and names it; a team link adds people once; one "Mentioned in" row per conversation and item, readable by the conversation's readers.
- `src/features/spine/references/chat.test.ts` · "message and conversation references" · proves AC9.4, AC15.3 · Both kinds render link, chip, card and preview; "Deleted message"; "Private item" with no title in the DOM.
- `tests/chat-capture.spec.ts` · "Make a task and ⌘7" · proves AC9.5, AC9.6, AC2.4, AC1.13 · `T` opens the capture with the From chip and the linked project; ⏎ shows "Became a task" live and the task's Linked shows the message; ⌘7 needs a destination, starts a direct message from a person and shows "Sent to … · Open · Undo".
- `src/features/chat/composer/composer.test.ts` · "grammar, handle chip, IME" · proves AC4.1, AC9.7, AC4.7 · `MOD-142` becomes a chip and Esc keeps the text; `@` `#` `/` tokens; `/task` opens the capture; ⏎ during composition doesn't send.

`chat_links.test.sql` is shared with CV-13 (the link half): this block writes the "Mentioned in" half (one row per conversation and item, readable by the conversation's readers). `composer.test.ts` already exists from CV-7b; add the handle-chip cases if they are not there.

## 4. Decisions that bind it

- **Two reference kinds** (#5, round-3 §2.25 d; spec §8 "References"): *conversation* `moduo://chat_channel/<id>` and *message* `moduo://chat_message/<id>`. Conversations are registered in `entities` already (label = name, none for a DM). A message registers **only when something links to it**, through `chat_op_register_message(message)`, **without a label**; ⌘K's Messages come from `chat_search` (CV-19), not registry rows. `chat_message_refs(ids)` returns a message's chip and card (author, conversation, time, first words) for messages the caller can read and nothing for the rest, so unreadable ones draw "Private item" with no title in the DOM; a deleted one "Deleted message". Client: `src/features/spine/references/` (`kinds.ts`, `types.ts`, `resolvers.ts`, `open.ts`, `ui/*`).
- **"Mentioned in"** (#6, §2.21): `chat_op_send` and `chat_op_edit` (**live bodies**; CV-2a, 5 and 9 changed them) write one `entity_links` row per conversation and referenced item (source the conversation, relation `mentions`, origin `ref`; the pair key keeps it one); edits and deletes don't remove it (history). Readable only by people who can read the conversation (CV-1's rule). `chat_conversations_for_item(type, id)`, **mentions half**: the "Mentioned in Acme · Oct 12" lines the caller can read; they show in any item's Linked (`src/features/spine/ui/entity-hub.tsx`, `src/features/contacts/ui/linked-sections.tsx`).
- **Make a task** (§8): Chat sets a capture source (`src/lib/capture-source.ts`: add a message kind; its `resolve` calls `chat_op_register_message` on create, only if the chip is kept) so the capture opens with the words as the title draft and a removable "From: Sofia's message in Acme" chip; destination the linked project (CV-13 adds links: Inbox until then); ⏎ creates it, the message shows "Became a task: ○ Get logo SVGs · Today" live, the task's Linked shows the message. `T` on a message and ⋯ → Make a task; `/task`, `/note`, `/event` from the composer do the same. Files stay on the message.
- **Typed handle** (CH66): `MOD-142` becomes a live chip as you type, Esc or ⌘Z keeps the text (RF-1's `src/features/spine/references/handle-autolink-plugin.tsx`; the stored form is the URI).
- **Message capture** (§8, CH65, #10): `src/features/chat/capture-type.tsx` (pattern `src/features/notes/capture-type.tsx`) added to `CAPTURE_TYPES` in `src/lib/capture-registry.ts` (`chat` is already a `CaptureModule`; ⌘7): no default destination, the picker opens focused (recent conversations and people first, a person starts a direct message), a "From:" item becomes a reference card in the message, ⏎ sends and shows "Sent to Acme · Open · Undo" (#33; Undo deletes it within 8 s).

## 7. Watch out

- Round-3 §5 risk 11: link rows must not reach more readers than the conversation; test as outsider, plain member and key.
- **Tier 2** (migrations, RLS, contracts, moduo-mcp, src/lib/runtime*): one `/code-review high` and one security scan of the diff at the end; scan findings go only into the hand-back.
- **Migration:** stamp provisional (re-cut on apply day, chat's order kept); redefine from live bodies (`pg_get_functiondef`); re-state grants by name (`DROP` + `CREATE` resets them); re-assert the Realtime publication if you publish a table; apply only on your migration turn, then `bun run db:test chat`; never `local:reset` or `migration up` (runbook, `docs/gotchas/supabase.md`).
- **Hot files:** `src/lib/runtime.chat.web.ts` and `src/features/chat/store/*`. Keep edits there small; another builder may change them too.
- **Public repo:** describe no security weakness in any file; tell the orchestrator in the hand-back.
